en: Black‑and‑white street view showing a slightly sloping main street lined with two‑storey wooden and masonry buildings. Several pedestrians walk along the road, and there are business signs on the façades. At the top center of the image is the printed caption "Storgatan, Vilhelmina". On the right, a larger building bears the painted sign "VILHELMINA KOO…". A hand‑written style code "Js. 58‑2." appears in the lower right corner.
